title: Accessibility
description: “The Cal State LA University-Student Union (U-SU) is committed to digital accessibility for all. Our website follows ADA, Section 504, Section 508, and WCAG 2.1 standards to ensure equal access. Features include screen reader compatibility, captions, alternative text, keyboard navigation, and more. Report accessibility issues at graffixwebteam@gmail.com or (323) 343-2464.”

title: Giving
description: Your gift to the University-Student Union at Cal State LA directly invests in the daily lives of Golden Eagle students by funding the programs and spaces where campus community happens. Contributions help us host engaging events, leadership opportunities, and cultural celebrations that keep students connected and supported outside the classroom. Your support also provides up-to-date equipment, welcoming student spaces, and meaningful on-campus jobs that offer both income and real-world experience. By giving to the U-SU, you’re helping ensure that every student has access to a vibrant, inclusive campus life where they can belong, grow, and thrive.
